remarks: Turnkey and fully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath Colonial Split on a quiet cul-de-sac in a highly convenient Stamford location. Offering approximately 2,877 sq ft, the home features a comfortable layout with a fireplace and French doors opening to a large deck and private backyard. The updated kitchen includes new countertops, refreshed cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a gas range, with great natural light throughout. Refinished hardwood floors and recessed lighting add a clean, updated feel. The flexible lower level works well as a family room, gym, or game room. Flat, fenced yard with updated landscaping. Enjoy easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Trader Joe's, shopping, dining, and everyday essentials.
